transkrip_resmi.judul_resmi: Pertemuan Bilateral Presiden RI dengan Presiden Amerika Serikat di White House, Washington DC, Amerika Serikat, 12 November 2024
transkrip_resmi.teks: Sambutan Presiden Prabowo Subianto pada Pertemuan Bilateral Presiden RI dengan Presiden Amerika Serikat, 12 November 2024 Thank you, thank you President Biden, thank you for receiving me. I also would like to thank you, you phoned me, yourself, upon my election and the… yeah thank you very much and then finally I could make it, and you receive me today. The United States, for us, is a very great friend. The United States supported us in our struggle for independence and helped us many times in our time of need. Therefore, I will work very hard to strengthen Indonesian – United States relationship. And I would like to work towards this end that we have a strong cooperation. Once again, President Biden, thank you very much for receiving me. Thank you, sir. Thank you, sir.
